title: 基本操作｜stack：用 list（append、pop）
question:
stack（堆疊）是「後進先出」：就像一疊盤子，最後放上去的最先拿走。
Python 的 list 就可以當 stack 用：append(x) 放到最上面、pop() 拿掉最上面的、a[-1] 是最上面的那一個、len(a) == 0 就是空的。
請支援三種指令：
1 x：把 x 放到最上面（push）
2：拿掉最上面的（pop）；如果是空的，輸出 Empty!
3：輸出最上面的數字（top）；如果是空的，輸出 Empty!
第一行輸入 N，接下來 N 行每行一個指令。每個要輸出的結果各輸出一行。
提示：每一行指令的數字個數不一樣，可以讀成一個 list：c = list(map(int, input().split()))，c[0] 是指令、c[1] 是要放的數字。

test_case.note: 拿掉 20 之後頂端是 10；10 也拿掉之後，pop 和 top 都是空的

en.title: Basics | stack: a list (append, pop)
en.question:
A stack is "last in, first out", like a pile of plates: the last one on top comes off first.
A Python list works as a stack: append(x) puts x on top, pop() removes the top, a[-1] is the top item, and len(a) == 0 means empty.
Support three commands:
1 x: put x on top (push)
2: remove the top (pop). If it is empty, output Empty!
3: output the top number (top). If it is empty, output Empty!
The first line is N. Then N lines, one command each. Output each result on its own line.
Tip: the lines have different numbers of values, so read each one as a list: c = list(map(int, input().split())). c[0] is the command and c[1] is the number.

test_case.note: After popping 20 the top is 10. After popping 10, pop and top find it empty
